2027 서울 세계청년대회를 위한 묵주기도 10억 단 봉헌운동 — 본당: The 1 Billion Rosary Decades campaign for WYD Seoul 2027 — how to take part through the parish box, the Hasang app, the website or groups, and the archdiocese’s running total.
묵주기도 10억 단 봉헌운동 | 암사동성당 WYD 2027: 1 Billion Rosary Decades | Amsa-dong Parish WYD 2027
2027 서울 세계청년대회를 위해 서울대교구가 2024년 2월부터 대회: A prayer campaign of the Archdiocese of Seoul for WYD Seoul 2027, running from February 2024 until the event. Clergy, religious and lay faithful all prepare for World Youth Day with the Rosary.
Put one bead in the Rosary box at the Amsa-dong Parish office for every five decades. The parish counts them weekly and reports to the archdiocese, and in 2027 the beads will be made into real rosaries.
누구나 하상앱이나 대회 홈페이지에서 바친 단수를 직접 봉헌할 수 있습니다: Anyone can log the decades they pray in the Hasang app or on the WYD website. Online entries are limited to 25 decades per 2 hours.
본당이 아닌 단체는 대표자가 단수를 모아 봉헌합니다. 단체 계정을 신청하: Groups other than parishes offer their decades through a representative: apply for a group account and, once it is approved the next day, log decades with it.
참여 방법 자세히: More on how to take part
10월 묵주기도 성월, 성모상 앞 꽃다발 판에 한 단마다 스티커를 붙여: In October, the month of the Rosary, we added a sticker for each decade to the bouquet board before the statue of Mary and filled 100 roses together.
묵주기도와 함께 바치는 기도: Prayers to say with the Rosary
묵주기도 시작이나 끝에 「젊은이를 위한 기도」와 WYD 공식 기도문을 함: At the start or end of the Rosary, pray the Prayer for Young People and the official WYD prayer.
현황 숫자는 교구 봉헌통계에서 30분마다 새로 불러옵니다. 불러오지 못하: Figures are refreshed every 30 minutes from the archdiocese’s statistics; if they can’t be loaded, the last saved figures are shown. Sources: Archdiocese of Seoul 1 Billion Rosary Decades campaign (wyd.catholic.or.kr), Catholic Times (2024.2.13).
